notes.title: Acolyte Voice Within Update Available Now!
notes.content:
The first major update to our natural-language narrative ARG is AVAILABLE NOW, alongside our first sale for the game, with 25% off for a full week. 

The Acolyte Voice Within Update brings some key new functionality to the game, including:

 Full, dynamic AI voice-over 
 New 'Daily Horoscope' module 
 New facts added
 New jokes added 
 100s of lines of new dialogue
 Improved Hint system 
 Performance Improvements 
 Additional fixes & polish 

The TTS (Text to Speech) feature is the real star of the show here, melding with the game's Natural Language Input to offer dynamic voice-over, bringing your Acolyte to life through spoken word. Here, we've partnered with ReadSpeaker to give Ana her voice, which not only benefits the narrative of the game, but also introduces an important layer of accessibility that was missing before now. 

Check out the brand new trailer here: 

[previewyoutube=rYT1R5N8QNY;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks, and until next time.

Jamin & The Superstring Team

Play Acolyte today!

notes.title: Acolyte v1.0.1 Update Now Live
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39563146/81fef1e0777b9766a23944d87943d0d721da5349.png

First things first: HUGE thanks to those of you that have picked up Acolyte and chucked yourself down the rabbit-hole of ARG sleuthing. I've been watching as many streams and videos of the game as I can, and seeing how different players tackle the game via its open-ended input is fascinating. 

To the small subset of players that have managed to solve all the game's puzzles: kudos. The game game has - and I quote the NME review here - "some of the hardest video game puzzles you’ll ever solve" - so to welcome some of you to the elusive Club100 so soon has been a pleasant surprise. 

There will be a bigger update with more substantial feature additions in due course, but I wanted to get a first patch out the door as soon after launch as possible to address a few of the smaller issues that have been cropping up. 

In this first update to the game, we've added: 


 Expanded valid-inputs for certain puzzle solutions
 Revised hints for certain puzzles 
 Improved scene flow for moving between LOI (Lines of Investigation)
 A fix for the 'Crossing the Ts and Dotting the Is' Achievement not popping for some players 
 New additional valid responses for the 'GET TO KNOW YOUR ACOLYTE' task. 
 A bunch of very boring but very needed typo-fixes


And that's it for this very minor first patch. 

Huge thanks once again to everybody that has checked out the game. 

Jamin & The Superstring Team

Play Acolyte today!

notes.title: The Big 'One Week Until Launch' FAQ!
notes.content:
We are now one week from the launch of Acolyte. In seven days time, the game that Superstring has been working on for the past three years will land on Steam. 

Questions about the game? We've got you covered. 

ACOLYTE HAS ‘ARG ELEMENTS’? WHAT DOES THAT MEAN!?
It means that the game also takes place outside of the game client itself. To unravel Acolyte’s mystery and solve some of its puzzles, you’ll need to expand your thinking, and be prepared to think outside the box….

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39563146/41c15c30c72cf8c377d41963c69d587405f45b83.png

I'M STUCK ON PUZZLE [x] - WHAT DO I DO?
Firstly, please don't post story/puzzle spoilers here on Steam or otherwise - half the fun is working out what to do here, but they can involve some 'out of the box thinking'. If you're really stuck and think there might be a proper, real life bug - please get in touch - support[at]superstring[dot]studio

I'VE FOUND A *REAL* BUG!
Ack! Sorry! Acolyte will still be receiving updates post launch. Please let us know your issue here on the Steam boards or email support[at]superstring[dot]studio, and we'll fix it up asap for you. Apologies for any trouble here.

DO I NEED AN INTERNET CONNECTION TO PLAY?
Not as such, no. You can play Acolyte without any connection at all, but in order to experience the full story and be able to solve certain puzzles, you will need access to various web pages.

WHY DOES ACOLYTE HAVE A PORTRAIT RESOLUTION?
Acolyte is designed to emulate a mobile device. The full release will also be coming to mobile, but the PC version also retains this resolution to best suit it’s design. The game is also designed to be played in a way that allows you access to other windows and tabs…

WHAT'S THE PLOT OF ACOLYTE? GIVE ME THE GIST!
You got it! In this Steam post we take a look at the company of Nanomax, and the world of the game that you'll inhabit as a new employee of the company.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39563146/6c0dc5993ce5a3d39abe7e3f9c41a583ee401436.png

CAN I CLEAR MY SAVE DATA TO PLAY AGAIN?
Yup. There's a button for this off the main menu by hitting Escape.

WHAT IS "CLUB 100"?
Ah, saw that did you? Be one of the few to 100% Acolyte - solving all its puzzles - and you'll gain entry to the highly exclusive Club 100 and earn your place in the game's credits.

--

And that's it for now.  Until next Tuesday, then! 

Acolyte is due for release June 28th 2022. Wishlist now!

notes.title: Acolyte Release Date Moved to June 28th
notes.content:
I’ve made the difficult decision to push the release of Acolyte by a month. Due to the natural language input at the heart of the experience, there are an infinite number of ways a player might interact with the game and it’s puzzles, and my general feeling is that the game can be much tighter, and deliver a more polished experience. 

At this stage of production, Acolyte is developed by a team of one; canvasing the game and properly testing the infinitude of routes through it is tough work. I want to dedicate some extra time to playtesting the final versions of the game, squashing bugs, and generally ensuring the game is in the best shape it can be for launch. 

Thanks for your patience, and rest assured - come June 28th - that it will all be worth it.

Missed it? You can watch the new trailer below:

More soon.

--

notes.title: Acolyte - An Alternate Reality Game
notes.content:
Not only is Acolyte a natural language game - meaning you can talk freely without pre-defined dialogue options - it's also an ARG. This means that the game spills out of the game client itself, and starts to unfold across the web. 

Everything spins around the fictional company of Nanomax, who you'll 'work for' as a QA tester when you begin the game. The nature of your relationship to Nanomax will change as the story-progresses, but the company is a constant throughout the narrative. 

The ARG components of Acolyte are largely tied to this tech company, and their real-world presence. You'll be trawling through their web presence, social media accounts and internal documentation in your investigation to expose their true intentions. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39563146/c73770c9619393fc35cccc205bab0e6ba82b3041.png

This means, as a detective style experience, you'll need to think outside the box, and apply very different logic to your puzzle-solving. Leaving the game experience for the first time might feel odd - or even like you're cheating - but it's very much by design. While you don't *technically* need an internet connection to play, many of the answers and solutions can only be found as your investigation begins to unfold over the internet. 

There is little hand-holding here, but you are, of course, not alone. Ana - your Acolyte - is the Watson to your Holmes, and can be leaned on for help and clues as you need. A lot of the time she has the answers already, but needs to be asked the right questions. Once you fall into a good rhythm and relationship with your Acolyte, puzzle answers will come more naturally. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39563146/41c15c30c72cf8c377d41963c69d587405f45b83.png

Now I don't want to spoil any puzzle answers here, but the full game will include puzzles the likes of which you've  likely not seen before, or at least not in a narrative game like this. We can't wait to see the discussion and support that the growing community might bring to the final game. 

More soon.

--

Acolyte is due for release May 26th 2022. Wishlist now!

notes.title: Interacting With Your Acolyte | 10 Features of Your Digital Assistant
Welcome to Nanomax, the World of Acolyte
notes.content:
In our upcoming natural language ARG/Detective game, you are a character in the story -- not a character that you might assume the role of, but you.

Today’s update aims to shine a bit of a light on the world that you’ll be immersing yourself in: the world of the technology company, Nanomax.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39563146/6c0dc5993ce5a3d39abe7e3f9c41a583ee401436.png

You'll start the game as a new employee of the well-funded tech start up. Specifically, you’re brought on board as a QA tester for the company’s upcoming flagship product – the digital assistant and lifestyle companion app: Acolyte. 

In your role as a QA Tester for the product, you’ll be able to submit bugs, and generally help shape the ongoing development of the application. But the more you learn about its developers (your employers), the further down a disturbing rabbit hole you'll fall...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39563146/67669534eda21696e166c89b848222a28938fae5.png

Nanomax was founded by Fiona Nightingale. A tech-savant and poster-child of the AI scene. Nightingale’s vision is to bring a more personal touch to digital assistants, and give the world a digital PA that can enhance and enrich lives across both business and leisure.

But is all her celebrity and PR built on a lie?

With the release of Acolyte (the app, that is, in the fiction of the game) on the horizon, the importance of the QA team in readying the tech for launch is very high. Particularly because of an elusive, highly severe bug that Nanomax wants to find and purge at all costs. 

It's this bug - Error51 - that sets the wheels in motion for you, fresh to the company's QA department, discovering worrying truths behind the technology that you're working on. 

As an employee of Nanomax, you’ll have access to all the resources you’d expect of a company: email, company address book, HR, a manager. 

But the resources don’t stop within the confines of the game itself. As part of the wider experience, you’ll be accessing the company’s website - www.nanomax.technology - the social media profiles of its employees, and various other web-based locations related to Nanomax. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39563146/41c15c30c72cf8c377d41963c69d587405f45b83.png

And this is where the ARG component of the game surfaces, as your investigation into the company tasks you with finding answers to a cover-up in the real world. 

The ARG component of Acolyte is something we'll take a deeper dive into in a future post...

–

Acolyte is due for release May 26th 2022. Wishlist now!

notes.title: Acolyte Will Launch on May 26th, 2022
notes.content:
It’s taken a little while to put a date to Acolyte, but we’re finally there. 

Out ambitious natural language detective/ARG title will launch on Steam on May 26th, 2022. Just around the corner, then. 

Since the release of Acolyte: Prologue a year ago, we have doubled down on the game’s innovative ARG elements, with a new focus on bold puzzles that will see players having to dig deep and summon their inner detective as they leave the confines of the game itself. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39563146/6ed8da16456e622acfec570db256f4c05ff3d2f1.png

An official selected title of London Games Festival 2021, Acolyte features writing and narrative design from George Lockett and Olivia Wood (Sunless Skies, Fallen London and Where the Water Tastes Like Wine), who have helped to shape the game’s branching story, weaving it together with bold ARG puzzles that take place across the web and social media.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39563146/41c15c30c72cf8c377d41963c69d587405f45b83.png

We'll have a series of Dev Blogs here on Steam taking a closer look at various elements of the game in the run up to launch - so stay tuned for more very soon. 

Acolyte has been in development since the release of Superstring's first game, Headspun, and we can't wait to share it with narrative, puzzle and detective game fans alike.
